question: For the customer who paid 634.8 in 2012/8/25, what was the consumption decrease rate from Year 2012 to 2013?

details.reason: Complete results differ from Gold SQL; BIRD Soft F1 = 0.0
details.actual_sql:
SELECT
    y.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END))
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS decrease_rate
FROM yearmonth y
WHERE y.customer_id IN (
    SELECT t.customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-25'
    GROUP BY t.customer_id
    HAVING SUM(t.price) = 634.8
)
  AND (y.date LIKE '2012%' OR y.date LIKE '2013%')
GROUP BY y.customer_id
details.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2013' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM yearmonth WHERE customer_id = (SELECT T1.customer_id FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.gas_station_id = T2.gas_station_id WHERE T1.date = '2012-08-25' AND T1.price = 1513.12)
